feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: How will tariffs affect the midterms? In this Michigan border town, it's complicated
entry.summary: The recent trade war between the U.S. and Canada has both economic and political implications for Michigan given it's the state's top trade partner.

entry.title: Israel bars U.S. citizens over criticism and ties to Palestinian activists, lawyers say
entry.summary: Travelers from the U.S. and other nations are denied entry to Israel after interrogations about their links to Palestinians, plans to visit the occupied West Bank and opinions of Israel, lawyers say.

entry.title: ICE detainee dies just hours after he was admitted into detention
entry.summary: Lianyong Wei's death marks the 57th death of an immigrant detainee held in the care of the government since the start of President Trump's second term. Twenty-four of those have occurred since Jan. 1.

entry.title: He died of 'natural causes.' But his mother says she knows what killed him: heat
entry.summary: When Arizona counts heat-related deaths, Adam Willson isn't included. His story shows how thousands of heat deaths can go uncounted every year in the United States.

entry.title: Germany blames Russia for last month's attempted drone attack at Leipzig airport
entry.summary: The German government blamed Russia for an attempted attack at Leipzig airport last month using a drone laden with explosives. It announced that it would shut down a Russian consulate among measures.

entry.title: U.S. military strikes Iran, while Trump vows more for Tehran's retaliation
entry.summary: The U.S. military hit targets in Iran on Tuesday and Tehran fired missiles and drones at various sites across the region in response as hostilities flare once again in an intermittent war.

entry.title: North Carolina Rep. Chuck Edwards is formally censured over harassment allegations
entry.summary: The censure vote drew bipartisan support, and followed an investigation by the House Ethics Committee into allegations of sexual harassment against two young female staff members.

entry.title: A week after the deadly floods in Nepal, rescuers work to find survivors
entry.summary: Nearly a week after flash floods devastated parts of Nepal and Tibet, rescuers are still searching for people trapped in hydropower plants. But first they have to find the plants.

entry.title: 'Damage happened here.' In Marlon James' new novel, the violence has a point
entry.summary: NPR's Juana Summers talks with award-winning author Marlon James about his new book, The Disappearers, the story of a brutal attack on a group of gay men in Jamaica and its aftermath.

entry.title: Congress averts a government shutdown ahead of the midterms
entry.summary: With just a few weeks to spare, the House approved legislation extending funding through mid-December.
